lines:
classDiagram
    class FormatVersionV1 {
      +String family
      +UInt major
      +UInt minor
      +String[] requiredFeatures
      +String hashAlgorithm
    }
    class PortableSessionManifestV1 {
      +SessionId sessionId
      +ChatId chatId
      +RunId runId
      +Hash frozenSnapshotHash
      +BranchId canonicalBranchId
      +String exportPolicyHash
    }
    class PortableFrozenSnapshotV1 {
      +Hash snapshotHash
      +Hash workflowHash
      +String[] logicalRequirements
      +String[] omissionFacts
    }
    class BranchManifestV1 {
      +BranchId branchId
      +SessionId sessionId
      +Hash branchManifestHash
      +ParentLineageV1 parent
    }
    class ParentLineageV1 {
      +SessionId parentSessionId
      +BranchId parentBranchId
      +Hash parentCheckpointHash
      +Hash parentHeadRecordHash
    }
    class BranchHeadRefV1 {
      +BranchId branchId
      +Hash headRecordHash
      +UInt refGeneration
    }
    class HeadRecordV1 {
      +Hash headRecordHash
      +Hash previousHeadRecordHash
      +Hash headSegmentHash
      +Hash checkpointHash
      +UInt nextOrdinal
      +CommitId commitId
    }
    class PortableCheckpointRecordV1 {
      +Hash checkpointHash
      +EventId lastEventId
      +UInt aggregateVersion
      +Hash snapshotHash
    }
    class SegmentHeaderV1 {
      +Hash segmentHash
      +Hash parentSegmentHash
      +Hash baseCheckpointHash
      +UInt firstOrdinal
      +UInt eventCount
    }
    class PortableSemanticEventV1 {
      +EventId eventId
      +SessionId sessionId
      +BranchId branchId
      +UInt branchOrdinal
      +String semanticKind
      +Hash payloadHash
    }
    class ArtifactRefV1 {
      +ArtifactId sha256Digest
      +UInt byteLength
      +String mediaType
      +Hash descriptorHash
    }
    class ProjectFileRefV1 {
      +WorkspaceId workspaceId
      +String relativePath
      +Hash expectedContentHash
    }

    PortableSessionManifestV1 --> FormatVersionV1 : declares
    PortableSessionManifestV1 --> PortableFrozenSnapshotV1 : frozenSnapshotHash
    PortableSessionManifestV1 --> BranchManifestV1 : canonical branch
    BranchManifestV1 --> ParentLineageV1 : optional fork lineage
    BranchManifestV1 --> BranchHeadRefV1 : atomic ref
    BranchHeadRefV1 --> HeadRecordV1 : headRecordHash
    HeadRecordV1 --> HeadRecordV1 : previousHeadRecordHash
    HeadRecordV1 --> PortableCheckpointRecordV1 : checkpointHash
    HeadRecordV1 --> SegmentHeaderV1 : headSegmentHash
    SegmentHeaderV1 --> SegmentHeaderV1 : parentSegmentHash
    SegmentHeaderV1 "1" *-- "1..*" PortableSemanticEventV1 : ordered JSONL lines
    PortableSemanticEventV1 --> ArtifactRefV1 : permitted evidence
    PortableSemanticEventV1 --> ProjectFileRefV1 : project-relative reference

data.title: Portable session, branch, segment, event, artifact, and reference lineage
